title_zh: 林俊杰：新加坡出生的华语乐坛「音乐才子」
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (10/20): JJ Lin, Singapore-Born "Musical Prodigy" of Chinese Pop
note_en: 无论…都… means "no matter...," and the result in the second clause stays the same whatever fills the first: 无论在哪里举行演唱会，现场都坐满观众 "wherever he holds a concert, the venue is packed." English needs only "wherever" or "no matter where," but Chinese pairs 无论 with 都 in the main clause, and the question word (哪里) inside the 无论 clause is required.
